rationale: The implementation of the Release Notification Top Bar is clean, modern, fully accessible, and completely decouples the release notification from blocking modals. High unit test coverage has been added and all tests are passing cleanly.

business_review.item: Decouple Release Notification from Blocking Modals
business_review.notes: Completely eliminated the release modal dialog and backdrop from AutoPopupManager.tsx.
Delivered ReleaseNotificationBar.tsx matching the approved gradient styling, close functionality, and accessibility roles.
Release bar is suppressed if the Admin Announcement Banner is active.
Release bar is suppressed during initial SSO P1 onboarding intro flow.
First-visit page popups trigger without waiting on release modal dismissal.

standards_review.notes: Implementation enforces Valtio snapshot reactivity for async configs subscription, deduplicates hash and storage key prefix in appInfoStore, uses standard Tailwind min-h-12 h-12 spacing, and exports DISMISSED_RELEASE_BAR_KEY for test assertions. Typecheck, lint, and unit test coverage checks passed completely.
